name: reconcile_history
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,re,hashlib,subprocess,sys,base64
lane=pathlib.Path.cwd(); allow=json.loads((lane/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); rows=json.loads((lane/'reservation.json').read_text())['rows']; terms=[str(r['mathdb_id']) for r in rows]+[r['source_url'].split('/')[-1] for r in rows]; out=[]
for name,h in allow.items():
 if any(s in name.lower() for s in ['expanded-corpus-r426','expanded-corpus-r428','r395','code-loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','bunkbed','hat-formal']): continue
 p=pathlib.Path(name); b=p.read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==h
 s=b.decode(); hits=[]
 for m in re.finditer('|'.join(re.escape(t) for t in terms),s):
  hits.append(s[max(0,m.start()-230):m.end()+700])
 if hits: out.append({'path':name,'sha256':h,'hits':hits})
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'history-reconciliation.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
prov=json.loads((lane/'original-provenance.json').read_text())
for r in prov:
 raw=base64.b64decode(r['raw_base64']); token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw).group(1); decoded=json.loads(token).encode();r.update(statement_token_base64=base64.b64encode(token).decode(),statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),statement_utf8_base64=base64.b64encode(decoded).decode(),statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest())
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'original-provenance.json'],input=json.dumps(prov,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('DENIALS',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in json.loads((lane/'inherited-denials.json').read_text()).items() if k in ['blocked_artifacts','blocked_keys']}))
